limits: Exact rotor annulus, toleranced hub/hat section, bolt engagement and compatible pad/caliper package are not established. Catalog cross-references do not authorize automatic substitution.

WABCO9253800250 is retained as a legacy development reference; the manufacturer-listed0460 alternative is not selected or qualified. Exact supply, maximum service/parking force and combined-force cases remain open.
The chamber/caliper axial mating datum and complete OEM material contours remain provisional. The source-supported89mm port-face ordinate does not establish boss or port-cavity geometry.
The8mm thread insertion and20mm fitting envelope are explicit scenarios. Two below-face interface reservations remain unresolved; separating them is not a physical-clearance acceptance.
Cast11 means service and cast12 means spring/parking, but their assignment to the97/116mm axial port stations is not established.
Forty constant-length hose curves are geometric samples. Actual fixed fittings/clamps, straight leads, cut lengths, torsion allowance, pressure growth and flex/abrasion validation remain open.
The chamber withdrawal screen excludes the unknown caliper mating seat and actual tools. Pad/retainer/spring/pressure-plate extraction and caging/tool access are not accepted.

Actual maximum brake torque, bearing application/minimum load, fits, key contact, bolt preload, weld fatigue, materials and vehicle dynamic loads remain unqualified.10kNm is a comparison load, not a brake rating.
Only one brake installation is modeled. Remaining locations, full service/spring air distribution and anti-compounding circuit are deferred.
Discrete geometry samples do not establish continuous motion, manufacturing tolerances, structural flexure or an operating release.
